task: Add hostile evidence coverage for a source-free generic member requirement identity.
observation: A body-only mutation of the member name did not exercise whether the importer bound the summary operation and provenance identity to the checked body target. A new hostile case changes the summary operation and provenance declaration ID, aligns the body's target/name/ordinal, recomputes the body and summary hashes, and reseals the ABI and archive marker. The consumer rejects this artifact with SOURCE_FREE_SUMMARY_INVALID before a checked-body projection trace appears.
impact: The mutation gives direct evidence that importer identity/order validation rejects a coherent forged summary-to-body linkage instead of relying only on malformed-body checks.

resolution.summary: The architect's WP2 P2 coverage note is closed; the corrected mutation passes the source-free pre-projection rejection assertion.
